summary: Frontend regression test for the reported React 'insertBefore' NotFoundError on /create when clicking 'Générer mon aperçu'. Executed 2 Playwright flows on the public URL: (1) full happy-path with small MP4 + JPG, consent, generate; (2) navigate-away mid-processing. Both flows completed with 0 pageerrors and 0 insertBefore errors. Progress bar rendered, backend produced a job, app navigated cleanly to /preview/:id (mock fallback due to depleted fal.ai credits, as expected).
critical_code_review_comments: Create.jsx: button icon+span are now stable siblings (no fragment ternary) — good fix for reconciler crash.
Poll interval is stored in useRef and cleared on unmount via mountedRef — clean lifecycle handling.
setTimeout(0) before navigate() ensures React commit finishes before route change — prevents mid-commit unmount race.
index.html has translate=no and meta google=notranslate — mitigates Chrome auto-translate DOM mutations that cause insertBefore crashes.
seed_data_creation: Generated small test MP4 (11KB) + JPG (10KB) via ffmpeg testsrc at /tmp/testfiles/
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified. Universal Key balance depleted so backend uses mock provider (returns original video as preview) — expected. If credits restored, verify real fal.ai swap path.
rca of the issue: Original crash was caused by React reconciler failing to insertBefore an unstable child structure inside the generate button (fragment with ternary swapping between icon and spinner) combined with Chrome auto-translate mutating the DOM. Fix stabilized DOM (fixed icon+span structure), disabled translate at document level, and deferred navigate() to next tick so React commits before unmount. Verified: no insertBefore/pageerror in either happy-path or unmount-mid-processing scenarios.
